title: Talk
consentText: A calm conversation with the mascot, to sort out what you feel. It does not replace professional help and never takes sides.
consentPrivacy: What you write is sent to an AI model only to produce the reply. Nothing from the conversation is kept, unless you turn a reply into a slip.
emptyHint: Say how you are, or start with something small.
offline: You're offline. The chat resumes when you reconnect.
limitText: Come back tomorrow, or see Plus to talk more.
plusTitle: The chat is part of Plus
plusText: The mascot is available on Plus, with 20 messages a day.
crisisText: It sounds like you are going through something very heavy. If you are in danger right now, call your local emergency service or reach someone you trust. I am not the right help for this.
unavailableTitle: The chat is not available right now

errors(map).RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a moment.
errors(map).other: Couldn't do that right now. Try again.
